dedupe_keys.name: nlr routee powertrain and compass vehicle energy prediction over road links and energy aware routing

description: RouteE is the National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) open source suite for vehicle energy estimation and energy-aware routing, made up of RouteE Powertrain, RouteE Compass and a simplified RouteE API. Contents: RouteE Powertrain is a Python package that predicts a vehicle's energy use over a route from congestion, speed, road type, lanes, grade and turns, with pretrained models for light-duty to heavy-duty trucks and transit buses (conventional, hybrid, battery electric and fuel cell) built from a million miles of drive-cycle data in NLR's Transportation Secure Data Center and FASTSim powertrain models; users can train their own. RouteE Compass, a Rust application with Python bindings, puts those predictions into network routing for any vehicle type. Producer: NLR Transportation and Mobility Research; the page notes a partnership with Google Maps on fuel-efficient routing launched in 2021 and work with transit and commercial fleets. Coverage: United States road networks and driving conditions. Format and access: open source code on GitHub (routee-powertrain, routee-compass) and API documentation on the NLR developer network. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): BSD-3-Clause (RouteE Powertrain and RouteE Compass). Caveats: pretrained models reflect US driving samples. Simulation uses: link-level energy costs for traffic and freight models, transit bus electrification route selection, corridor energy analysis and transit resilience planning. Related records: model-nlr-hive-highly-integrated-vehicle-ecosystem-fleet-charging-simulation and model-nlr-altrios.
